fullPassage:
Becoming aware of our internal sensations can help us handle our own emotions. Perhaps more surprisingly, the body's interoceptive faculty can also bring us into closer contact with other people's emotions. That's because the brain, on its own, has no direct access to the contents of other people's minds, no way to feel what others are feeling. Interpreting others' spoken words and facial expressions may yield only a coolly abstract sense of the emotions that stir within. The body acts as a critical conduit, supplying the brain with the visceral information it lacks. It does so in this way: When interacting with other people, we subtly and unconsciously mimic their facial expressions, gestures, posture, and vocal pitch. Then, via the interoception of our own bodies' signals, we perceive what the other person is feeling because we feel it in ourselves. We bring other people's feelings onboard, and the body is the bridge. In an act similar to taking a bite off our partner's plate, or borrowing an earbud to hear the song our friend is listening to, we are ____________________.

* interoceptive: 내부 감각 수용의 ** conduit: 전달자 *** visceral: 본능적인

questions.passage:
Becoming aware of our internal sensations can help us handle our own emotions. Perhaps more surprisingly, the body's interoceptive faculty can also bring us into closer contact with other people's emotions. That's because the brain, on its own, has no direct access to the contents of other people's minds. The body acts as a critical conduit, supplying the brain with the visceral information it lacks. We bring other people's feelings onboard, and the body is the bridge.

* interoceptive: 내부 감각 수용의 ** conduit: 전달자 *** visceral: 본능적인
questions.stem:
위 글에서 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 단어를 찾아 쓰시오.

몸은 뇌에 부족한 본능적 정보를 공급하는 중요한 __________ 역할을 한다.

det.korean: 원문: 'a critical conduit' → conduit(전달자)
det.analysis: ✅ conduit: 본문에서 몸이 중요한 전달자(conduit) 역할을 한다고 직접 언급
det.tip: conduit = 전달자, 통로: 정보가 흐르는 경로의 비유

questions.passage:
When interacting with other people, we subtly and unconsciously mimic their facial expressions, gestures, posture, and vocal pitch. The body acts as a critical conduit, __________ (supply) the brain with the visceral information it lacks.

* conduit: 전달자 ** visceral: 본능적인
questions.stem: 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오.

det.korean: supply → supplying: 분사구문으로 주절의 동시동작을 나타내는 현재분사.
det.analysis: ✅ supplying: 주어(The body)가 능동적으로 공급 → 현재분사
det.tip: 분사구문: 주어 동일 + 능동 → 현재분사(-ing)

det.korean: no way to feel what others are feeling: 타인이 느끼는 것을 느낄 방법이 없다.
det.analysis: no way(방법이 없다) + to feel(느낄) + what others are feeling(타인이 느끼고 있는 것을)
det.tip: no way to ~ = ~할 방법이 없다. what절 = 간접의문문/관계대명사

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

"다른 사람과 상호작용할 때, 우리는 미묘하게 그리고 무의식적으로 그들의 표정을 모방한다."

When interacting with other people, we subtly and unconsciously __________ their facial expressions.

det.korean: 모방하다 = mimic
det.analysis: ✅ mimic: 원문 그대로. '모방하다'에 해당하는 동사.
det.tip: mimic = imitate = copy: '모방하다'

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

"타인의 말과 표정을 해석하면 차갑고 추상적인 감각만 산출할 수 있다."

Interpreting others' spoken words and facial expressions may __________ only a coolly abstract sense of the emotions.

det.korean: 산출하다 = yield
det.analysis: ✅ yield: 원문 그대로. '산출하다, 가져다주다'에 해당하는 동사.
det.tip: yield = produce = generate: '산출하다'. may + 동사원형이므로 원형 yield 사용
